newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements on Monday, a New York Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
The operation was generally expected, although analysts figured the Fed would do multi-day RPs to take care of its projected $6.5 billion a day add need.
Fed funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent when the Fed entered the market, right at the current official target level.
Analysts also noted that there was a very good chance the Fed could add permanent reserves to the banking system this week by buying coupons or, more likely, bills.
